ai_summary: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited has set August 28, 2026, as the record date for determining shareholders eligible to receive a proposed dividend of Rs. 2.25 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26. While this intimation signifies a potential payout for eligible investors, the dividend is contingent upon approval at the Annual General Meeting on September 11, 2026, with payment expected within seven days post-declaration; no red flags are apparent in this standard regulatory filing.
